items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh. Well an acquaintance named Art Bailey gave me that little inside scoop. [INTERVIEWEE] Well yeah, that’s cool. I bet I told Art that.

ctx.x: Oh where’d you hear that? It was started as a — I think it was — I don’t know it could have been Dick Wittington my piano player friend, another part of our clique, Dick, or it was a piano player named Marty Harris that I played with a lot too and he used to call me, Dick called me the “bebop Walter Winchell.”
Oh. Well an acquaintance named Art Bailey gave me that little inside scoop.
Well yeah, that’s cool. I bet I told Art that.
